text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And claiming victory in this fierce battle 
across generations is―― Silence Suzuka! 
It's Silence Suzuka!
(WAAAAAHHHH...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Silence Suzuka...! She's 
just like a whirlwind...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Hasn't she gotten even faster than she 
was in the Takarazuka Kinen?!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Both Grass Wonder and El Condor Pasa ran 
great races, but... the competition was 
just insane...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ngaaaaaaaahhhhh--!! I'm frustrated, 
frustrated, so frustrated, YES!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I gave it my all!! I was 
weak!! I still didn't measure up!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Still... I swear I'll overtake you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Until then, you ab-so-lute-ly must remain 
the "Unearthly Escape Artist"!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Suzuka-senpai. Someday, again. Without 
fail...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—Gaaah! The word "weak" is hitting me with 
a delayed critical blow!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Geez, El, honestly...

—The fever pitch of the venue after that 
fierce battle did not subside for quite 
some time.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!
choice_data_list: That was a great race, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...In that race just now, I ran so well, 
I surprised even myself."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I'm not even myself, like I 
could fly away... to anywhere...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Is it really okay for me to keep 
running like this?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You're right. Everything will be fine.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I'm sorry. That was rather 
strange of me to say.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, come to think of it, where's 
Spe-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
W-Welcome back! I'm sorry for leaving 
without saying anything...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No. More importantly... are you alright? I 
heard you were feeling down...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, umm...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Well, um...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you and Grass-chan trying to 
overtake Suzuka-san—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I felt truly envious.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't just sit by, it made me so 
restless... I wanted to join in too, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan......

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Watching Suzuka-san's race... I've never 
felt this way before...!

Feeling Grass Wonder and El Condor Pasa's 
passionate feelings toward Silence Suzuka 
firsthand—

To her, Silence Suzuka had also changed 
from 'someone to chase' to 'someone to 
surpass.'

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ... ...Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... to Spe-chan, I've 
become... a "light"...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ..."Light," you say?

Special Week murmured, her face gradually 
brightening up.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes! That might be true!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... I see, so that's what this was 
all about. ...What a relief.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I thought... maybe it was some really 
dirty feeling...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...No way. If you really feel that way, 
Spe-chan, that makes me so very happy.

Seeing Silence Suzuka's happy smile, 
Special Week smiled warmly in return.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: E-Ehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I need to do my best so Spe-chan doesn't 
pass me...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, that's... I still have a long way 
to go!"

The Mainichi Okan ended up providing each 
Umamusume with their own unique 
inspiration.

The winner, Silence Suzuka's next 
objective is—

—This will be the long-awaited Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)...!
